x-http.notes: Morning has no dedicated summary/aggregation endpoint (confirmed against the Postman collection) — aggregated client-side over /documents/search results for the resolved date range. KNOWN LIMITATION (confirmed live 2026-07-08): cancelling an invoice issues a linked Credit Invoice (type 330) but does not change the original invoice's own `status`, and Morning does not return `linkedDocumentIds` on read for either document, so a specific cancelled invoice cannot be excluded from the paid/unpaid tally without this app persisting that mapping itself (it deliberately does not — see plan.md, stateless). As an accounting approximation: counts/paid/unpaid classification are computed only over primary sale document types (305 tax invoice, 320 invoice+receipt); Credit Invoice (330) amounts are netted out of total_invoiced so a cancelled invoice's face value doesn't inflate reported revenue, but its count still appears in invoice_count/unpaid_invoice_count.
